device.description: dual 16-bit voltage-output DAC with 16-bit parallel interface, input-register read-back, LOADDACS and reset to mid scale
device.note: dac7642.pdf (SBAS233) p.1 (description: DAC7642 resets to 8000H), p.3-4 (specifications: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, VIH 0.7 VCC), p.5 (pin configuration and descriptions), p.16 (digital interface), p.17 (Table I truth table, coding, Figure 14), p.18 (Table II timing)

registers.name: INA
registers.note: DAC A input register (Table I: DACSEL = 0); RST loads 8000H; power-on code not stated (RST code used)

registers.name: INB
registers.note: DAC B input register (Table I: DACSEL = 1); RST loads 8000H; power-on code not stated (RST code used)

registers.name: DACA
registers.note: DAC A DAC register; both loaded from the input registers on the LOADDACS rising edge (Table I)

registers.name: DACB
registers.note: DAC B DAC register; both loaded from the input registers on the LOADDACS rising edge (Table I)

commands.name: Write input (CS low, R/W low)
commands.note: Table I: DACSEL low selects input register A, high B; data valid tDS before / tDH after CS rising (Figure 14)

protocol.note: Table I: CS low with R/W high reads back the input register DACSEL selects on DB15-DB0 (tCSD 150 ns max, tDZ 100 ns max)

ldac.note: DAC output registers load, rising-edge triggered (p.5, Table I)

reset.note: RST is rising-edge triggered (Table I: L or H in normal operation); modeled as a level reset while RST is low (holding RST low blocks writes in the model)

pages: p.1 (description: DAC7642 resets to 8000H), p.3-4 (specifications: VCC 4.75-5.25 V, VIH 0.7 VCC), p.5 (pin configuration and descriptions), p.16 (digital interface), p.17 (Table I truth table, coding, Figure 14), p.18 (Table II timing)
notModeled: analog: outputs, force/sense pins, differential reference inputs, single/dual supply operation, settling
RST is rising-edge triggered and either level is normal operation; modeled as a level reset active low to 8000H, so a design that leaves RST low stays in reset in the model
power-on state of the registers is not stated in the datasheet (the RST code 8000H is used)
DAC registers are not readable (Table I reads back the input registers only)
pin 29 is printed 'VOUTL' in the pin-description table (described as the reference low input) and 'VREFL' in the pin configuration drawing; named VREFL here
variants: DAC7643 (same dac7642.pdf, resets to 0000H) is not in this skeleton. DAC7642VFT / VFBT are linearity grades of the same chip.
